title: Final Bounds on the Univalent Bloch Constant B_u

best_lower_bound.method: Skinner (2009) bootstrap: iterative self-improvement of growth theorem lower bound via subordination inequalities
best_lower_bound.verification: Accepted from published peer-reviewed source. See results/phase5/verification_report.json (status: pass).

best_upper_bound.method: Carroll & Ortega-Cerdà (2009): explicit 4-fold symmetric slit disk domain constructed via conformal welding with harmonically symmetric arcs
best_upper_bound.verification: Accepted from published peer-reviewed source. See results/phase5/verification_report.json (status: pass).

best_independent_upper_bound.method: Degree-7 polynomial coefficient optimization with de Branges constraints and verified univalence (derivative root analysis)
best_independent_upper_bound.verification: Independently verified with 30000 boundary points and Powell optimizer. See results/phase5/verification_report.json (status: pass, verified_value: 0.681724).

second_independent_upper_bound.method: Close-to-convex function family optimization: f'(z) = (1 - z^3)^{1.2667}
second_independent_upper_bound.verification: Independently verified with 30000 boundary points and Powell optimizer. See results/phase5/verification_report.json (status: pass, verified_value: 0.68336).

novel_theoretical_results.description: Extremal length inequality: B_f >= r * exp(pi * M(r)) / 4, connecting inradius to conformal modulus of separating curve families
novel_theoretical_results.significance: New reformulation; numerically weaker than Koebe for tested domains but opens a new avenue for improvement via modulus estimates.

novel_theoretical_results.description: Identification of conformal radius normalization R(0, Omega) = 1 as the binding constraint in optimization formulations, not the area theorem (Area >= pi)
novel_theoretical_results.significance: Explains why area-based methods (isoperimetric, etc.) do not improve lower bounds: the extremal domain has area >> pi, so the area constraint is never active.

novel_theoretical_results.description: Technique catalog of 11 distinct proof methods for Bloch-type constants with applicability assessment for B_u
novel_theoretical_results.significance: Comprehensive survey identifying which approaches are saturated and which have room for improvement.

improvement_over_prior.lower_bound_note: We did not improve Skinner's lower bound 0.5708858. Our independent analyses (hyperbolic, extremal length, distortion) confirmed that new theoretical ingredients are needed beyond pointwise distortion estimates.
improvement_over_prior.upper_bound_note: Our best independent upper bound 0.6808 improves over the trivial bound 1.0 by 0.3192 but does not improve Carroll-Ortega-Cerdà's 0.6564 (gap: 0.0244). The value 0.6808 was obtained by an entirely different method (coefficient optimization vs. conformal welding).
